pages.text: Traveler's Backpack, OreSpawn tailoring: three boss-hide skins with the full feature set intact. You carried the fight to them; they carry your stuff home.$(p)Each one is crafted around a standard backpack — the hide is the upgrade, the engineering underneath is stock, and the strap art shows on your back the moment you wear it.

pages.title: The Collection
pages.text: Left to right: Mobzilla-Hide in black and purple scale plate, Kraken in teal with sucker prints, Girlfriend's in pink with a heart clasp. The suckers don't do anything. They're suckers.
Six Godzilla Scales, two Mobzilla Scale blocks, one standard pack. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/mobzilla)Mobzilla$() about sourcing.
Four Kraken Teeth, four Sea Monster Scales, one standard pack. The $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/kraken)Kraken$() contributes reluctantly.
Pink wool, poppies, and two heart boxes of chocolates from her own kitchen. No OreSpawn Delight in the pack? The grid accepts hearts instead.

pages.title: Standard Issue, Boss Grade
pages.text: Everything a Traveler's Backpack does, these do: full inventory, both side fluid tanks, the sleeping bag, tool slots, and wearable on your back through Curios or Accessories. Tier upgrades apply exactly as they would to a stock pack — bigger storage, bigger tanks, same hide.$(p)Owning any of the three earns Pack Mule Royalty. The pink one also earns a diary mention — see $(l:orespawn_integrations:her_side/date_night)Date Night$().
